newsitem.title: USA: ValueVision takes 5.1 pct stake in CML.
newsitem.headline: ValueVision takes 5.1 pct stake in CML.

text.p: ValueVision International Inc said Wednesday it notified the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that it and an affiliate own 2,538,000 shares or about 5.1 percent of the shares outstanding of CML Group Inc, as of July 30.
ValueVision is an integrated electronic and print media direct marketing company and the nation's third-largest television home-shopping network.

ValueVision said it and its affiliate acquired the shares of common stock of CML Group for investment purposes, but it plans to seek discussions with CMl management about various general operational, marketing and financial aspects of CML's business.

ValueVision said it and its affiliate also may seek to have further substantive conversations with CML management to discuss various ways in which the two companies may work together for the mutual benefit of their businesses. This would include, but not be limited to, possible working synergies that may be available in television, direct mail and retail-supportive marketing endeavors.
ValueVision said it and its affiliate may also seek to engage in discussions with other CML stockholders with respect to ways in which the value of the common stock of CML Group may be enhanced.
